name: nd-search
description: Search the web, read the clean text of a page by URL, crawl a few pages of one site and search Telegram channels through the NeuralDeep Search API with an sk- key. A standard-library Python client takes the key from --api-key or NEURALDEEP_API_KEY, prints compact text or the raw JSON and exits with meaningful codes.

interface.shortDescription: Web search, page reading and crawling through the NeuralDeep Search API.
